hooks.prompt: Review the Python file that was just modified. The modified file path is in tool_input.file_path. If the file does not end in .py, output nothing and stop. Otherwise, review it for: naming clarity, DRY violations, overly broad exception handling, and security issues. Only report MUST FIX level problems. Be concise — one line per issue maximum.

Before finishing, check if any Python files were modified this turn by running: git diff HEAD --name-only | grep '\.py$'. For each changed .py file, review it for MUST FIX issues only: naming clarity, DRY violations, overly broad exception handling, security issues. If no .py files were changed, output nothing. Be concise — one line per issue maximum.
